description: This file contains the implementation of the ClientClusterManifestProvider class, which manages cluster manifest data for external clients in the Orleans runtime. It handles starting/stopping the provider, updating cluster manifests asynchronously, and interacting with other Orleans components such as gateways and system targets.

classes.name: ClientClusterManifestProvider
classes.description: Implements IClusterManifestProvider for external clients, managing cluster manifest updates asynchronously, providing current manifest data, and handling lifecycle events.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Starts the manifest provider asynchronously, initiating the background run task.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the provider asynchronously, cancelling ongoing operations and waiting for the run task to complete.

methods.name: RunAsync
methods.description: Main loop that periodically fetches and updates the cluster manifest from gateways.

methods.name: GetClusterManifestUpdate
methods.description: Fetches the latest cluster manifest update from the provider, falling back to an older API if necessary.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes of the provider, cancelling ongoing tasks.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the provider synchronously, cancelling ongoing operations.
